text:
Aisha (Partnerships): Quick kickoff: goal is to onboard LangChain/LlamaIndex gateway adapter into the marketplace + coordinate joint comms. Who's owning what? :spiral_calendar:
Liam (Eng Integrations): I'll own the adapter repo polish and the sample app. Main open item is the marketplace auth pattern for connectors (short-lived creds).
Rina (Product): I'll draft the marketplace listing schema and example flows. Need the sample app steps and a one-click run guide.
Omar (Marketing): We want a 2-line benefit statement, a GIF, and a hero screenshot. Target publish date = 2 weeks out.
Priya (Legal): We'll need partner approval for the co-branded asset and to check trademark usage. Share the copy early.
Liam (Eng Integrations): For auth, use this snippet in README for dev tokens:
```
export RW_TOKEN=$(curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.ai/token -d '{"grant_type":"client_credentials"}')
```
Liam (Eng Integrations): Smoke test plan: `scripts/smoke_test.sh` calls the adapter, verifies a small convo and embedding retrieval. ci-bot: CI job `adapter-marketplace-smoke` will run on PR merge.
Aisha (Partnerships): Good. Rina, can product own the "examples" tab content and the runbook for marketplace reviewers?
Rina (Product): Yes. I'll include a short checklist: 1) creds setup, 2) run smoke, 3) verify telemetry scrubbed, 4) export sample logs.
Priya (Legal): Add explicit note: do not log user PII in examples. We'll sign off faster if that's clear.
Liam (Eng Integrations): Adding an anonymize-logs helper to the sample app now. Will tag PR with `marketplace-ready` when done.
Omar (Marketing): Draft headline idea: "Ship production-ready gateway adapters for Redwood + LangChain". Will iterate. Also need a 10s GIF of the app flow after smoke passes.
Aisha (Partnerships): Timeline: today - align owners; +2 days - sample app + README draft; +4 days - marketplace copy + marketing assets; +7 days - partner legal signoff; +10 days - publish. Flag any delays.
Liam (Eng Integrations): ETA for PR: +2 days. If smoke fails, will extend by 24h.
Rina (Product): I'll drop initial marketplace copy tomorrow and prototype the examples tab.
Priya (Legal): I'll prioritize review once copy is in, aim for 48h turnaround.
ci-bot: adapter-marketplace-smoke queued for branch `feature/marketplace-onboard`  status: pending
Omar (Marketing): 44d marking as follow-up. Need to confirm which customer quote (if any) we can include.
Aisha (Partnerships): I'll check with the partner on co-branding and any quote approvals. Pulling in partner comms doc later.
Liam (Eng Integrations): Putting a small howto in the README: "Local dev -> run smoke -> capture GIF -> push". Will keep it under 5 minutes to run.
Rina (Product): Also adding a tiny troubleshooting section for common adapter errors (auth, schema mismatch).
Aisha (Partnerships): Awesome. Action items recap: Liam = sample app + smoke + GIF; Rina = marketplace listing + examples tab + README; Omar = announcement draft + assets; Priya = legal review; Aisha = partner coordination + timeline doc.
Omar (Marketing): 4e2 will prepare announcement cadence once assets land.
Priya (Legal): 44d
Liam (Eng Integrations): Will ping here if CI flaps.
Aisha (Partnerships): Thanks team. If anyone hits a blocker, reply with "BLOCKER" so we can triage quickly.
